name: moonlight-peaks-ps5-launch-nov-17
lines:
باعت اللعبة
أكثر من 300 ألف نسخة منذ يوليو
headline:
تصدر Moonlight Peaks
على PS5 الليلة
label: جديد
spoken: تصدر Moonlight Peaks على PS5 الليلة. تؤدي فيها دور مصاص دماء يعود إلى مزرعة عائلته ليزرعها، ويصادق أهل البلدة ويجرب الهوايات. وقد باعت اللعبة أكثر من 300 ألف نسخة منذ يوليو.

Primary read in full; time and first rep.evidence: XSEED/Marvelous USA press release 27 Oct 2026 read in full on Games Press 15 Nov ~11:05Z ('coming to PlayStation 5 on Nov. 17, 2026', 300,000 units, $34.99, PS Plus 20% 17 to 23 Nov, Premium two-hour trial); PS Store UAE page read 15 Nov ~11:00Z: 'Releases on: 16/11/2026 08:00 PM UTC' = 00:00 Dubai Tue 17 Nov

Not already posted (ledger find, Publer.evidence: git grep moonlight/xseed over newsroom/stories: only the 28 Oct date announcement (stills Reel); this is the launch itself, real news under the variety rule

Older than 24 h at first report and noth.evidence: a dated launch: the UAE store unlocks it at 00:00 Dubai the night of the slot's day; the store hour is new since 28 Oct

Angle before lines (hook, why now, what.evidence: story file angle: cozy vampire life sim lands on PS5 at midnight UAE time; the UAE store unlocks it tonight; Gulf PS5 players can download it from midnight, PS Plus 20% off launch week; payoff 300,000 copies sold since July

Story type items (OUT NOW: platforms, AE.evidence: PS5 digital in headline and caption; no AED price on the UAE store before release, USD from the publisher in the caption only; what it is: a life sim as a vampire on a farm (lines and caption)

One spoken paragraph first, cut into bea.evidence: spoken = headline + 4 lines read in order

Subject named before any pronoun; no lin.evidence: Moonlight Peaks named in the headline before فيها; line 3 opens on و continuing line 2 back to back (under 3 s)

Release verbs.evidence: تصدر ... الليلة (the store's date and hour); no bare تصل

Names match names-ar; new names added.evidence: إكسيد غيمز (XSEED Games) as in the 28 Oct story, ليتل تشيكن (Little Chicken Game Company): rows added to names-ar; مصاص دماء and لعبة محاكاة الحياة added as terms

Headline: what happened, names the reade.evidence: تصدر Moonlight Peaks / على PS5 الليلة

Lines open the story, not repeat the hea.evidence: lines: who you play, the farm, the town and hobbies, the sales figure

Caption first line carries the news, sou.evidence: لعبة Moonlight Peaks تصدر على PS5 الليلة عند منتصف الليل بتوقيت الإمارات; source XSEED and the PS Store page

X and Threads: one or two sentences, sou.evidence: حسب صفحتها على متجر PlayStation؛ وفق ناشرها إكسيد غيمز

Pinned comment: the source.evidence: المصدر: إعلان إكسيد غيمز (XSEED Games) في 27 أكتوبر وصفحة اللعبة على متجر PlayStation في الإمارات

Urgency: chip honest.evidence: جديد; not عاجل, not رسمي (store page plus a 27 Oct release)

Tone neutral; sensitive details general.evidence: vampire premise stated neutrally; witchcraft and romance left out of every text and shot (21 Oct rule)

Footage keeps its own sound; music named.evidence: Release Date Trailer's own music from 31.0 s (one stretch, server time), audio split with each shot's own effects

No speech under Arabic lines.evidence: faster-whisper small (numpy input) on the Release Date Trailer: speech only 28.58-29.98 s and a stray word at 90.7 s; the stretch from 31.0 s to about 49 s has none. Launch and Wholesome trailers are narrated throughout but only their effects stems come back (dialogue not put back)

Separated stems last resort.evidence: the server's audio split: continuous music stem, each shot's own effects

Footage first.evidence: three official Steam trailers (1920x1080), decode clean on the server prerender 15 Nov 10:56Z

Not the same picture as the last 5 Reels.evidence: a dark gothic farm and a character creator; neighbours a fighting expansion (UFC 6), Shrek 2 and TEKKEN

One visual requirement per beat; shot sh.evidence: cover: the young vampire walking her farm, centred under the crop rows, headline in the band above her; 1 s of the town shop as the headline fades (no line); line 1 the character creator, a young vampire with a black cat, the look changing; line 2 the crop rows with bats overhead; line 3 two townsfolk at a campfire then a flower arrangement (hobby); line 4 a crowd gathered on the beach (cut before a heart icon) then the town shop with a passer-by

Crop judged per beat.evidence: v2 Reel looked at 4 fps: with focus as the share of the crop's travel (not the centre), the creator at 0.30 cut the character at the left edge and showed the hairstyle panel's edge and the L button: v3 sets 0.18 (character and cat whole, button hints outside, checked on 9:16 crops at 2 fps); the cover moved to the farm walk because the creator's hair sat under the headline; farm 0.45, crop rows 0.5, flowers 0.5, beach 0.4, shop 0.70 look right in the v2 strip

Headline in the band, not over the subje.evidence: v3 cover: the farm walk; the vampire sits at about 55% of the height, the headline over the crop rows in the top band

Credit on every clip for its whole durat.evidence: credit [0,6] المصدر: إكسيد (XSEED) وليتل تشيكن (Little Chicken), frame 0 to the end card; publisher and studio named

Lifeless score below threshold.evidence: shots inside the server's clean stretches, all moving

Checks: what am I seeing, hearing, why t.evidence: hard cuts (cut true) so each line keeps its reading time; trailer music under every shot

Decision log complete.evidence: rejected: the doors shot (OCR flags 56.2-57.7 s), the tavern (text flags 38-40.5 s, lightning), the dark-magic cloud courtyard, the skull-faced shopkeeper, the heart icon at the campfire after 25.3 s, the pottery wheel (UI icon row at the top), the logo slates and key-art cards (logo and publisher strip); v2 (qc pass) not used: creator crop cut the character, hair under the headline, line 4 broke 300 from ألف, and a heart icon showed over the beach crowd at 14.0 s (shot now ends at 28.95 s source)
